result.title: The Fast Tree Transform
result.summary: The Fast Tree Transform is a locally-aggregated transform defined for arbitrary graph geometries that generalizes both the Hadamard frequency transform and the Haar wavelet transform on the circle. The pure frequency part of the transform approximately diagonalizes the graph Laplacian; this fact makes it useful as a preconditioner in geometric optimization problems. The full transform provides an only slightly-redundant representation of signals on the graph that allows sparse representation of signals that include both edges and textures.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Fast Tree Transform：一种定义在任意图几何上的局部聚合变换，推广了圆上的 Hadamard 频率变换与 Haar 小波变换，其纯频率部分近似对角化图 Laplacian，可用于几何优化中的预条件，并对同时含边缘与纹理的信号给出近似无冗余的稀疏表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 该变换在图结构上提供多尺度、稀疏的信号分解，或可作为分析 VLM 内部状态（如 token 图、注意力图）表示几何与局部-全局成分的工具，但其与 LVR 的状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策的关联需较多核查，目前仅属概念性启发。
